parameters.name: AggregationInterval
parameters.description: The new sampling interval of the flow log. Unit: minutes. Valid values: **1**, **5**, and **10**.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description:
The new description of the flow log.

The description must be 1 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

parameters.name: FlowLogName
parameters.description:
The new name of the flow log.

The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

parameters.name: IpVersion
parameters.description: The IP version of the traffic captured by the flow log.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the flow log.

You can call [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) to query the most recent region list.
